title: Local Roundup: Wyoming Area players reach volleyball milestones - NewsBreak
text:
By John Erzar [email protected] ,
20 hours ago Wyoming Area volleyball players Taylor Gashi, left, and Kenzie Galenty reached career milestones in a victory over Mid Valley on Wednesday. Gashi recorded her 500th dig while Galenty served her 100th ace. Submitted photo Kenzie Galenty and Taylor Gashi reached career milestones as Wyoming Area defeated Mid Valley 3-0 Wednesday in a non-conference girls volleyball match.
Galenty served her 100th ace and now has 102. Gashi posted her 500th dig and finished the match with 505.
The Warriors won by scores of 25-16, 25-19, 25-21.
Galenty (15 digs, 4 aces, 1 kill), Gashi (18 kills, 7 digs, 5 aces, 2 blocks), Aubrey Lewis (3 kills, 3 digs, 1 ace), Sara Pealer (7 kills) and Ava Boyle (18 assists, 3 digs) were Wyoming Area’s top players.
Berwick 3, Tunkhannock 0
Berwick swept Tunkhannock 25-11, 25-19, 25-11.
Top players for Berwick were Jaiden Laidacker (4 aces, 16 service points), Lea Adamo (6 kills), Maliyah Esquilin (1 block, 2 kills, 1 assist, 1 dig), Grace Robbins (13 kills), Angie Colone (10 kills) and Julia Rauch (29 assists, 8 digs).
Crestwood 3, Hanover Area 0
Crestwood won by scores of 25-13, 25-14, 25-5.
Top players for Hanover Area were Emma Myers (3 points, 1 assist, 2 kills), Ilyssa Rinehimer (2 kills, 1 block, 4 points) and Amanda MacLunny (2 kills, 3 points, 2 aces).
Hazleton Area 3, MMI Prep 0
Hazleton Area defeated MMI Prep 25-12, 25-8, 25-12.
Top players for MMI were Cassidy McDermott (5 kills, 2 blocks, 4 points, 2 digs), Shreeya Parikh (2 kills, 13 assists, 4 points) and Anna Drobnock (1 kill, 4 digs, 5 points).
FIELD HOCKEY
Lackawanna Trail 3, Wyo. Valley West 1
Greta Krimmel scored two goals late in the third quarter as the Lions defeated Wyoming Valley West.
Natalia Salansky also scored for Trail. Valley West’s Ava Mullery moved the Spartans within a goal by scoring early in the fourth quarter.
Wyoming Seminary 4, Abington Heights 0
Emmy Swartz scored two goals in the first quarter as Wyoming Seminary shut out Abington Heights.
Rachel Snyder increased the lead to 3-0 at halftime. Apollonia Bruno added a fourth-quarter goal.
Tunkhannock 6, Hanover Area 0
McKenna Traver scored two goals as Tunkhannock defeated Hanover Area.
Ava Wisnosky, Kayla Slater, Kinsley Sechrist and Leah DeMarco also scored for Tunkhannock. Hannah Lawson, Hailey Bartron and Abigail Taylor added assists.
Wilkes-Barre Area 1, Delaware Valley 0
Kayce Martin scored off an assist from Hope Burke in the fourth quarter as the Wolfpack edged Delaware Valley.
WBA outshot Del Val 20-2 and had 27 penalty corners.
BOYS SOCCER
Lake-Lehman 4, Hanover Area 0
Aiden Gallagher scored one goal and added an assist as Lake-Lehman defeated Hanover Area.
Andrew Mathes and Hunter Palka also scored for the Black Knights. Andrew Morris had a pair of assists. Keeper Andrew Chapple had two saves.
GIRLS SOCCER
North Pocono 4, Wyoming Valley West 1
Olivia Charles scored two goals as North Pocono defeated Wyoming Valley West on Tuesday night.
Nora Singer scored for Valley West off an assist from Meghan Singer.
BOYS CROSS COUNTRY
Hazleton Area wins four
Hazleton Area came away with four victories in a cluster meet with six other teams.
Crestwood had three wins, Pittston Area had two and Wilkes-Barre Area and Wyoming Valley West had one apiece. MMI Prep and Wyoming Area didn’t score any victories.
The top-five finishers were Crestwood’s Mason Staude (16:40), Pittston Area’s Caden Boetlger (17:22), Hazleton Area’s Gavin Adam (17:32), Hazleton Area’s Christian Matos Mendez (17:46) and WBA’s Ben Delgado (17:48).
Redeemer, Northwest win three
Holy Redeemer and Northwest came away with three wins each in a seven-team cluster meet.
Hanover Area and Wyoming Seminary recorded two wins each. Berwick and Columbia-Montour Vo-Tech had one apiece.
Top-five finishers were Northwest’s Michael Fritz (17:04), Hanover Area’s Joseph Bly (18:15), Redeemer’s Joshua Cackowski (18:24), Redeemer’s Patrick Smith (18:25) and Berwick’s Brennan Spaide (18:41).
GIRLS CROSS COUNTRY
Comets, Cougars win four
Crestwood and Hazleton Area each came away with four wins in a seven-team cluster meet.
MMI Prep, Pittston Area, Wilkes-Barre Area and Wyoming Area each posted one victory.
The top-five finishers were Crestwood’s Katie Kozich (19:07), Crestwood’s Mollie Kozich (19:54), Pittston Area’s Bella Dessoye (20:03), Crestwood’s Riley Ruch (20:33) and WBA’s Alexi Prushinski (20:45).
Redeemer, Sem win three
Holy Redeemer and Wyoming Seminary won three races in a seven-team cluster meet.
Hanover Area and Northwest left with two wins each. Columbia-Montour Vo-Tech and Nanticoke had one win each.
Top-five finishers were Northwest’s Kayana Krall (21:03), Seminary’s Grace Rushmer (21:45), Redeemer’s Leah Smith (22:00), Redeemer’s Adele Deemer (22:04) and Seminary’s Celia Ludka (22:33).
